answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. The lotus of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The timber holds work receipts rather than names, so the tide of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
